note: Declared CSS initial values for the longhands this harness measures. A property is DECIDABLE for the unhydrated guard only when its initial value is declared here; an undeclared property makes the target undecidable and the guard fails closed rather than guessing. Values are the CSS specification's initial computed value as Chromium serialises it on a 16px root, because that is the exact string an element reports when no author rule reached it. Custom properties are not listed: their initial is the empty string and that rule is universal, so it lives in code rather than in this table.
sourceOfTruth: CSS Cascade/Box/Align/Fonts specifications, as serialised by getComputedStyle in Chromium at the pinned viewport
